correctness.rationale: Definition fixes all multihomomorphism cells. The standalone self-contained checker enumerates exactly 20,862 regular product cells, checks all signed second boundaries, and independently obtains F2 boundary ranks (854,4276,4275,684) by row and column reduction. This forces rational Betti vector (1,0,683,0,0) using universal coefficients and Euler characteristic. All 171 affine maps are checked on oriented cells; exact signed Lefschetz values agree on every element with the stated rational module, which Maschke semisimplicity makes a genuine isomorphism. Rational equivariant subdivision and invariants prove the quotient statement. No integral torsion or homotopy classification is inferred.

value.rationale: The oriented triangle is a naturally motivated equivariant test source in the foundational directed Hom-complex work, and the quadratic-residue P19 is the canonical nontransitive doubly regular target, not an arbitrary slice. The exact full affine homology module distinguishes its 5 invariant directions from 678 nontrivial ones, beyond Betti numbers. The quotient rational homology is a further structural consequence. It provides a self-contained benchmark beyond the previously handled smaller cyclic-target Hom case and the different Paley directed-flag complex.
